items.originalTitle: Fluid, natural voice translation with Gemini 3.5 Live Translate
items.summary:
Google has introduced Gemini 3.5 Live Translate, a new audio model that enables near real-time speech-to-speech translation in over 70 languages. This technology is integrated into Google AI Studio, Google Translate, and Google Meet, offering smooth, natural-sounding translations that maintain the speaker's intonation and pacing without awkward pauses.

The model continuously generates speech during conversations, staying just seconds behind the speaker to provide fluid audio. It supports multilingual inputs without manual configuration and is designed to work well in noisy environments. Gemini 3.5 Live Translate is available to developers via the Gemini Live API, in private preview for Google Meet enterprise users, and broadly through the Google Translate app on Android and iOS, enhancing live interpretation for calls, meetings, and broadcasts.

items.title: Google DeepMind introduces Gemma 4 12B, a unified encoder-free multimodal model with native audio input and laptop-ready efficiency [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.originalTitle: Introducing Gemma 4 12B: a unified, encoder-free multimodal model
items.summary:
Google DeepMind has introduced Gemma 4 12B, a new unified, encoder-free multimodal model designed to deliver advanced multimodal intelligence directly on laptops. This model supports native audio input and offers high-performance reasoning capabilities comparable to larger models, while maintaining a compact size that runs efficiently on devices with just 16GB of VRAM or unified memory. Released under an Apache 2.0 license, Gemma 4 12B aims to make powerful multimodal AI accessible and practical for a wide range of applications.

Gemma 4 12B features a novel architecture that eliminates separate multimodal encoders by integrating vision and audio inputs directly into the language model backbone. This approach reduces latency and memory usage, enabling faster and more efficient processing. The model replaces traditional vision encoders with a lightweight embedding module and projects raw audio signals into the same space as text tokens, streamlining multimodal input handling.

Developers can access Gemma 4 12B through various platforms and tools, including LM Studio, Ollama, and Google AI Edge apps, with pre-trained weights available on Hugging Face and Kaggle. The release also includes a Skills Repository to support agentic development and integration options for deployment on Google Cloud, facilitating versatile use cases from local inference to enterprise applications.

items.summary:
Google DeepMind has launched a three-month accelerator program to support 15 early-stage robotics startups across Europe. The program offers intensive mentorship, technical support, and access to advanced AI models to help these companies integrate artificial intelligence into their products and scale real-world applications. The selected startups work in diverse fields including healthcare, manufacturing, climate solutions, and logistics.

Participants in the accelerator receive hands-on guidance from Google DeepMind and Google experts, leveraging Google's AI stack and robotics models to transform cutting-edge research into practical robotic technologies. This initiative aims to advance the development of physical AI, enabling intelligent machines to interact more effectively and safely with the real world, addressing significant challenges through innovative robotics solutions.

items.summary:
Google DeepMind conducted a randomized controlled trial in Sierra Leone involving 1,763 junior secondary students to evaluate the impact of its AI-powered Gemini Guided Learning feature on math progress. Over eight weeks, students using Guided Learning showed significant improvements, with math scores increasing by up to 2.5 years of typical learning progress compared to a control group. The trial demonstrated high student engagement and a shift toward deeper conceptual understanding rather than simply seeking answers.

The study emphasized the role of teachers in facilitating AI-supported learning, with educators designing lessons and guiding classroom discussions. Teachers also reported professional growth through the use of Gemini, which helped them explain concepts more effectively. The trial's results suggest that AI can augment teaching by promoting critical thinking and active learning, rather than replacing educators.

DeepMind plans to conduct further trials globally to build a comprehensive evidence base on AI's impact in education. They are also releasing resources to help others implement similar AI-driven learning programs and are committed to advancing responsible AI development in education through ongoing research and collaboration.

items.originalTitle: Built to benefit everyone: our plan
items.summary:
OpenAI has outlined its plan to develop artificial general intelligence (AGI) with a focus on safety, accessibility, and broad societal benefit. The company emphasizes that AGI should empower people, distribute benefits widely, and remain aligned with human values and control to ensure it serves humanity as a whole.

The plan draws parallels to the transformative impact of electricity, highlighting AI's potential to enhance daily life and expand human capabilities across various fields. OpenAI stresses the importance of public coordination and international cooperation to manage risks and guide the development of AI technologies responsibly, aiming to prevent concentration of power and promote shared prosperity.

items.title: OpenAI launches Economic Research Exchange to fund external studies on AI’s impact on jobs, productivity, and the economy with applications open through July 2026 [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.originalTitle: Introducing the OpenAI Economic Research Exchange
items.summary:
OpenAI has launched the Economic Research Exchange, a new initiative to fund and support external research projects examining the economic impacts of artificial intelligence. The program invites researchers to propose studies that use OpenAI tools and datasets to generate rigorous, privacy-protected empirical evidence on how AI affects jobs, productivity, firms, and the broader economy. Applications for selected research collaborations are open until July 5, 2026, with notifications expected by the end of that month.

The Exchange aims to foster high-quality research through structured projects with clear milestones and data governance, focusing on areas such as labor economics, productivity, inequality, and public finance. This effort complements OpenAI's broader work to improve measurement of AI's economic effects and seeks to provide valuable insights for policymakers, businesses, and the public during a period of rapid technological change.

items.originalTitle: How Endava is redesigning software delivery around AI agents
items.summary:
Endava, a global technology services company, is transforming its software delivery by integrating OpenAI's ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex to embed AI agents into daily workflows. This approach accelerates software development, automates various business processes, and fosters an AI-native culture across its 11,000 employees worldwide.

The company developed DavaFlow, an AI-driven delivery methodology that incorporates OpenAI technology throughout the software lifecycle, from planning to deployment. Beyond engineering, AI adoption has expanded to legal, finance, and operations teams, streamlining tasks such as research, reporting, and project coordination. Endava emphasizes behavior change, leadership involvement, and experimentation as key factors in successful AI integration.

Looking ahead, Endava plans to advance enterprise AI by orchestrating models, agents, and workflows to reshape organizational operations. The company encourages others to embrace AI personally to stay relevant in the evolving technological landscape.

items.title: OpenAI rolls out Dreaming V3 memory system for ChatGPT Plus and Pro users in the US, improving context retention, preference tracking, and relevance across conversations [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.originalTitle: Dreaming: Better memory for a more helpful ChatGPT
items.summary:
OpenAI has launched Dreaming V3, an advanced memory system for ChatGPT Plus and Pro users in the US, designed to enhance the model's ability to retain context, track user preferences, and maintain relevance across conversations. This new system builds on previous memory features by synthesizing information from multiple interactions to provide fresher and more accurate responses without relying solely on explicit memory commands.

Dreaming V3 improves upon earlier versions by automatically curating and updating memories in the background, allowing ChatGPT to better understand ongoing user needs and preferences over time. Users can review and manage their stored memories through a summary page, enabling more personalized and context-aware interactions. The update aims to make ChatGPT more helpful by remembering useful details and adapting to changes, with plans to expand availability to more users and regions in the coming weeks.

items.title: OpenAI launches biodefense action plan leveraging GPT-Rosalind AI model to enhance biological threat detection and pandemic preparedness in 2026 [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.originalTitle: Biodefense in the Intelligence Age
items.summary:
OpenAI has launched a biodefense action plan centered around its advanced AI model, GPT-Rosalind, to enhance biological threat detection and pandemic preparedness. Introduced in April 2026, GPT-Rosalind supports research in biology, drug discovery, and medicine, aiming to improve health outcomes by accelerating scientific understanding and therapy development.

Recognizing the dual-use nature of these AI capabilities, OpenAI announced Rosalind Biodefense in May 2026 to empower trusted developers in building biodefense tools while emphasizing responsible use and governance. The action plan seeks to create a more resilient biological future by enabling earlier threat detection, faster countermeasure development, and more coordinated crisis responses.

items.title: OpenAI updates GPT-Rosalind with enhanced biological reasoning, medicinal chemistry, genomics analysis, and experimental workflow capabilities for life sciences research [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.originalTitle: Introducing new capabilities to GPT-Rosalind
items.summary:
OpenAI has released an updated version of GPT-Rosalind, a model designed specifically for life sciences research. The new update integrates GPT-5.5’s advanced coding and tool-use abilities with enhanced expertise in medicinal chemistry, genomics, and broader biological analysis, improving performance across drug discovery and experimental workflows.

The update was evaluated using LifeSciBench, a benchmark developed to assess models on comprehensive life sciences tasks including evidence handling, scientific reasoning, and experimental validation. GPT-Rosalind demonstrated significant gains in addressing complex research challenges, such as analyzing clinical trial data and supporting drug development decisions, and is now available for research preview to qualified organizations worldwide.

The plan suggests building on existing state laws and strengthening the role of the Center for AI Safety and Innovation (CAISI) as the primary federal institution overseeing AI safety. It also calls for a coordinated government-wide approach to address the challenges posed by advanced AI technologies.

The blueprint comes at a time when several states, including California, New York, and Illinois, have enacted frontier AI safety laws, and the White House has issued an executive order promoting AI innovation and security. OpenAI's proposal aims to create durable institutions capable of evolving alongside AI advancements to ensure responsible development and deployment.

Travelers has launched an AI-powered Claim Assistant nationwide, developed with OpenAI's Realtime API and advanced models, to provide customers with 24/7 support for filing auto property damage claims. The assistant guides users through the claims process using natural conversation, answers policy questions, and submits claims autonomously, helping Travelers manage high volumes during peak demand and catastrophe events.

Initially deployed in eight states, the AI Claim Assistant was expanded across the country within two months, with 85–90% of customers completing their claims through the system. This solution enables immediate customer assistance without wait times while allowing claim professionals to focus on more complex cases, enhancing operational efficiency and customer experience at scale.

items.originalTitle: Advancing youth safety and opportunity through global leadership
items.summary:
OpenAI has proposed the creation of a global AI Safety Institute aimed at enhancing protections and opportunities for young people as artificial intelligence becomes increasingly integrated into education and daily life. This initiative, highlighted ahead of the G7 Leaders’ Summit in June 2026, seeks to establish international collaboration to develop consistent safety standards, share research, and provide practical guidance for youth AI use.

The proposed institute would build on existing efforts like Common Sense Media’s Youth AI Safety Institute and partnerships with educators and researchers, including projects in Estonia and the United States. OpenAI emphasizes the importance of age-appropriate safeguards, regular risk assessments, parental controls, and transparent communication about AI’s benefits and risks to ensure safe and supportive AI experiences for young users.

OpenAI plans to work with governments, civil society, academia, and industry partners to promote sustained global leadership on youth AI safety, aiming to maintain momentum beyond the G7 summit and adapt to the evolving technological landscape.

items.title: OpenAI outlines its AI policy stance, supports transparent advocacy and thoughtful regulation, and clarifies no outside political group represents the company [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.originalTitle: Our views on AI policy and political advocacy
items.summary:
OpenAI has outlined its stance on AI policy and political advocacy, emphasizing transparency, support for thoughtful regulation, and AI safety. The company clarified that it does not have any employee-funded Political Action Committees (PACs), has not made donations to super PACs or political campaigns, and that no outside political group represents its views. OpenAI stresses that its policy positions should be judged by its public statements and actions, not by the personal political activities of its employees or affiliated individuals.

The company highlighted the importance of broad participation in shaping AI governance, involving governments, researchers, workers, civil society, and the public rather than any single organization. OpenAI also addressed questions about the organization Leading the Future (LTF), noting that any involvement by its president and co-founder, Greg Brockman, and his wife is strictly personal and not on behalf of the company. OpenAI advocates for clear, honest AI policy advocacy free from misleading tactics and commits to continuing its efforts transparently and directly.

items.title: OpenAI breaks ground on 1GW data center in Michigan with community partnerships, creating over 2,500 union construction jobs and investing $10 million in local projects [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.originalTitle: Building the infrastructure for the Intelligence Age in Michigan
items.summary:
OpenAI has begun construction on The Barn, a 1GW data center campus in Saline, Michigan, as part of its Stargate project to build AI infrastructure. The initiative aims to expand AI access, create over 2,500 union construction jobs, and invest $10 million in local community projects, including improvements to the Saline Recreation Center. The project also promises to protect local resources and prevent increased costs for local residents.

The data center will use a closed-loop cooling system to minimize water use and will not pass infrastructure costs onto local ratepayers. OpenAI is partnering with local organizations and government officials, including Governor Gretchen Whitmer, to ensure the project supports Michigan's workforce through union jobs and apprenticeship programs. Additionally, OpenAI plans to provide up to $45 million in Codex credits to eligible Michigan students to enhance AI literacy and workforce training.

This development is part of a broader effort to foster economic growth and technological leadership in Michigan, supporting local schools and services through projected tax revenues of $1 billion over the lease term. The project reflects a commitment to building AI infrastructure responsibly while investing in the communities that host it.

items.originalTitle: OpenAI frontier models and Codex are now available on AWS
items.summary:
OpenAI's frontier models and Codex are now generally available on AWS, enabling enterprises to integrate advanced AI capabilities within their existing AWS security, governance, and procurement frameworks. This integration allows organizations to accelerate AI adoption by using familiar AWS environments to move from evaluation to production more efficiently.

The availability includes OpenAI models and Codex on Amazon Bedrock, which supports AI application development with AWS-native controls. Customers such as Amgen and Autodesk highlight the benefits of deploying these models on AWS for enhancing scientific research and design workflows while maintaining high standards for security and operational governance.

Looking ahead, OpenAI and AWS plan to expand these offerings, including the introduction of Daybreak, a suite of cyber security tools designed to improve software resilience through AI-driven code review and threat analysis. This partnership aims to help more organizations deploy advanced AI solutions securely and effectively within their existing infrastructure.

items.title: Boston Children’s Hospital uses OpenAI-powered AI to diagnose over 40 rare diseases and save 60,000 operational hours, redeploying $7 million in labor [ ! ] [ ⬢ ]
items.originalTitle: Boston Children’s uses AI to unlock new diagnoses
items.summary:
Boston Children’s Hospital has integrated OpenAI-powered artificial intelligence into its clinical and operational workflows to enhance patient care, reduce costs, and improve efficiency. This implementation has enabled the hospital to diagnose over 40 rare diseases that were previously unresolved, save approximately 60,000 operational hours, and redeploy more than $7 million in labor through over 50 AI-driven automations.

The hospital developed an enterprise AI layer, a secure internal ChatGPT environment, to support various teams including clinical, research, and administrative staff. This system helps synthesize complex medical data, streamline scheduling, and automate routine tasks, allowing staff to focus on higher-value work. The AI tools have been embedded across the organization to meet specific needs, resulting in faster innovation cycles and broader adoption among employees.

By leveraging AI for both operational improvements and clinical discovery, Boston Children’s has significantly advanced its capacity to diagnose rare diseases and optimize resource allocation. The approach demonstrates how AI can be effectively integrated into healthcare infrastructure to address cognitive limits and operational challenges while improving patient outcomes.

items.summary:
OpenAI has launched Rosalind Biodefense, a new initiative designed to provide vetted developers and U.S. government partners with trusted access to GPT-Rosalind, its advanced AI model for life sciences research. This program aims to support the development of biodefense and pandemic preparedness tools by enabling the creation of applications that enhance public health and biological threat response capabilities.

The initiative builds on OpenAI's ongoing efforts to ensure the safe and responsible deployment of powerful AI in biology, including collaborations with government agencies and expert organizations. Rosalind Biodefense will sponsor access to GPT-Rosalind and assist trusted developers in building tools for epidemiological modeling, early detection, screening, and other public health measures, thereby strengthening societal resilience against future biological threats.

items.title: OpenAI shares guidance on designing trustworthy third-party AI evaluations for frontier model capabilities and safeguards [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.originalTitle: A shared playbook for trustworthy third party evaluations
items.summary:
OpenAI has published guidance on designing trustworthy third-party evaluations for frontier AI models, focusing on assessing capabilities, safeguards, and the validity of results. The guidance emphasizes the importance of clearly defining the claims being tested and providing evidence to support the evaluation's validity, especially as models now operate within complex environments using tools and multi-step workflows.

The guidance outlines different types of claims—capability elicitation, safeguard performance, and model comparison—and stresses the role of the evaluation setup, or "harness," in influencing performance outcomes. It also highlights common validity concerns such as reward hacking, refusals, contamination, broken problems, and sandbagging, recommending transparency about these factors to improve the reliability and usefulness of evaluation reports.

The framework builds on OpenAI's Preparedness Framework, detailing risk assessment and mitigation strategies for advanced AI systems, including areas like cybersecurity, harmful manipulation, and loss of control.

The document also addresses model reporting, security risk management, incident response, and the incorporation of external expert input. OpenAI plans to update the framework as AI capabilities and regulatory requirements evolve, ensuring ongoing alignment with legal obligations and safety best practices.

items.summary:
OpenAI and Thrive Holdings collaborated to develop a self-improving Tax AI using Codex, designed to automate and accelerate tax return preparation for over 30 accounting firms in Crete. The system processes complex tax filings, significantly reducing manual data entry time and improving accuracy, with the AI continuously enhancing its performance through structured feedback from real-world use.

During a pilot involving 7,000 tax returns, Tax AI saved practitioners about a third of their preparation time and achieved up to 97% accuracy in drafting returns. The AI's ability to self-improve was demonstrated by a rapid increase in the percentage of returns completed with high accuracy, enabling it to handle increasingly complex tax documents and workflows as the tax season progressed.

The development leveraged expert practitioner input, detailed production data, and a Codex-driven iteration loop to identify and address errors autonomously. This approach not only improved efficiency but also allowed for faster product development and adaptation to complex tax scenarios, offering a model for integrating AI with domain expertise in professional services.

items.summary:
OpenAI has outlined a series of safeguards for the 2026 global elections aimed at ensuring reliable voting information, supporting cyber defense efforts, and enhancing transparency around AI-generated content. Building on initiatives from 2024, OpenAI plans to provide live vote counts in the US and Brazil, partner with organizations to share accurate voting logistics, and improve web search results with source links to help users access trustworthy election information.

The company is also advancing cybersecurity through its Daybreak program, which includes tools like Codex Security to identify software vulnerabilities and Trusted Access for Cyber to support election system defenders. Additionally, OpenAI is implementing digital watermarking and metadata standards to help verify AI-generated images and combat misinformation, while collaborating with social media platforms and supporting legislation to promote transparency in election-related content.

items.summary:

This approach, called Open Agentic Development, allows human developers to define objectives and supervise outcomes while agents handle planning, coding, testing, and submitting changes.

Warp's orchestration platform, Oz, manages these agents by deploying and coordinating them across environments, supporting long-running workflows with features like persistent memory and context management. The use of GPT-5.5 improves efficiency by reducing token usage per task and enhances the agents' ability to reason across complex coding problems, helping Warp scale its agent-driven development processes effectively.

The partnership allows Folha de S.Paulo and UOL to reach new audiences worldwide while supporting the broader news ecosystem. It also grants these publishers access to OpenAI's tools such as Codex, ChatGPT Enterprise, and API, enabling them to explore innovative ways to use AI in journalism, improve workflows, and develop new products. Brazil is a significant market for ChatGPT, with more than 50 million monthly active users, highlighting the importance of this collaboration for both the media groups and OpenAI.

items.title: Virgin Atlantic uses Codex to ship revamped mobile app with near 100% unit test coverage and zero P1 defects before Christmas travel rush, accelerating legacy code refactoring by 80% [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.originalTitle: How Virgin Atlantic ships faster with Codex
items.summary:
Virgin Atlantic leveraged Codex to successfully launch its revamped mobile app ahead of the Christmas travel rush, achieving nearly 100% unit test coverage and zero priority one defects at launch. This approach allowed the airline to meet a critical deadline while maintaining high software quality, essential for customer operations such as check-in and boarding.

In addition to improving the mobile app, Codex significantly accelerated the refactoring of legacy code, reducing codebase size by up to 80% and cutting refactoring time from weeks to minutes. The technology also empowered analyst teams to rapidly prototype internal applications directly on the company’s data warehouse, enhancing efficiency across multiple departments.

Looking ahead, Virgin Atlantic aims to scale Codex’s benefits across its entire software development lifecycle, addressing the challenge of engineering speed outpacing other delivery processes. The airline views Codex as a transformative tool that extends beyond engineering, supporting broader organizational innovation and agility.

items.title: OpenAI model disproves 80-year-old planar unit distance conjecture in discrete geometry, marking first AI-solved major math problem [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.originalTitle: An OpenAI model has disproved a central conjecture in discrete geometry
items.summary:
An OpenAI model has disproved the 80-year-old planar unit distance conjecture, a central problem in discrete geometry originally posed by Paul Erdős. This breakthrough provides an infinite family of examples that improve on the previously believed optimal constructions, marking the first time an AI has autonomously solved a major open problem in mathematics. The proof, verified by external mathematicians, introduces sophisticated algebraic number theory techniques to address this longstanding question.

The model's success came from a general-purpose reasoning system rather than one specifically trained for mathematics or this problem, highlighting the advanced reasoning capabilities of current AI. Leading mathematicians have praised the result as a milestone in AI-driven mathematics, noting the model's originality and depth of insight. This achievement demonstrates AI's potential to contribute original ideas and complete complex proofs in frontier mathematical research.

items.title: OpenAI launches multi-year partnership with Singapore government to expand AI deployment, develop local talent, and support businesses and public services with over S$300 million investment [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.originalTitle: Introducing OpenAI for Singapore
items.summary:
OpenAI has launched a multi-year partnership with the Singapore government, committing over S$300 million to support the country's National AI strategy. The initiative, called OpenAI for Singapore, aims to expand AI deployment, develop local AI talent, and assist businesses and public services in leveraging AI technologies.

Central to the partnership is the establishment of OpenAI's first Applied AI Lab outside the United States, which will create more than 200 technical roles in Singapore. The lab will focus on advancing AI applications in public service, finance, healthcare, and digital infrastructure, while also collaborating with local partners to build AI skills through educational programs and workforce development initiatives.

This collaboration reflects Singapore's commitment to becoming an AI-powered economy by fostering innovation, strengthening enterprise adoption of AI, and preparing its workforce for future opportunities. OpenAI for Singapore also plans to support startups and small businesses in adopting AI to enhance their operations and customer service.

items.title: OpenAI advances AI content provenance with C2PA conformance, Google SynthID watermarking, and a public verification tool for AI-generated images [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.originalTitle: Advancing content provenance for a safer, more transparent AI ecosystem
items.summary:
OpenAI has enhanced its approach to AI content provenance by adopting the Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity (C2PA) standards, integrating Google's SynthID watermarking technology, and launching a public verification tool. These measures aim to help users verify the origin and authenticity of AI-generated images, improving transparency and trust in digital media.

The company has been embedding Content Credentials in images generated by its tools since 2024 and recently became a C2PA Conforming Generator Product, ensuring that provenance metadata can be preserved and recognized across platforms. To complement metadata, OpenAI partnered with Google DeepMind to add invisible SynthID watermarks that remain detectable even after common image transformations, enhancing the durability of provenance signals.

OpenAI's new public verification tool allows users to check whether images were created using OpenAI's models by detecting embedded provenance signals. This multi-layered strategy addresses challenges in content verification and supports a more trustworthy information ecosystem by making AI-generated content easier to identify and authenticate.

Google has expanded access to Project Genie for AI Ultra subscribers worldwide and introduced a new feature that integrates Google Street View imagery to create virtual environments grounded in real-world locations within the U.S. This enhancement allows users to generate imaginative, interactive worlds based on actual places, combining generative AI with real-world visuals for more immersive experiences.

Users can select a location on the map and apply various styles, such as "Ocean World" or "B&W film," to reimagine these places creatively, like exploring the Golden Gate Bridge underwater or viewing historical scenes of the Fort Worth Stockyards. Project Genie remains an experimental tool within Google Labs, with ongoing improvements planned to enhance accuracy and detail.

items.originalTitle: Introducing Gemini Omni
items.summary:
Google DeepMind has introduced Gemini Omni Flash, a new multimodal AI model capable of creating and editing videos using combined inputs of images, audio, video, and text through conversational commands. This model builds on Gemini's existing capabilities by enabling users to generate high-quality videos grounded in real-world knowledge and to edit them naturally by interacting with the system in multiple steps.

Gemini Omni Flash supports complex video editing tasks such as altering scenes, adding characters, and changing visual effects while maintaining consistency in physics and narrative. It leverages Gemini's understanding of physics, history, science, and culture to produce realistic and meaningful storytelling. The model is currently integrated into the Gemini app, Google Flow, and YouTube Shorts, with plans to expand support to other output formats like images and audio in the future.

items.title: Google DeepMind launches Gemini for Science, a suite of AI tools and experiments to accelerate scientific discovery and research across multiple fields [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.originalTitle: Gemini for Science: AI experiments and tools for a new era of discovery
items.summary:
Google DeepMind has introduced Gemini for Science, a suite of AI tools and experiments designed to enhance scientific discovery across various fields. This collection includes prototypes like Co-Scientist for hypothesis generation, AlphaEvolve and Empirical Research Assistance for computational discovery, and Google NotebookLM for literature insights, all aimed at accelerating key steps of the scientific method.

These tools help researchers manage the growing volume of scientific knowledge by automating complex tasks such as generating and evaluating hypotheses, running large-scale computational experiments, and synthesizing scientific literature. Gemini for Science is being gradually made available through Google Labs, with enterprise applications already in use by organizations like BASF and Bayer Crop Science to drive real-world research and development.

Additionally, the initiative includes Science Skills, which integrates data from major life science databases to streamline workflows in areas like structural bioinformatics and genomics. This approach aims to empower scientists by expanding the scale and precision of their research, potentially transforming how scientific challenges are addressed.

items.title: Google expands content transparency tools with SynthID watermarking and C2PA credentials across Search, Gemini, Chrome, Pixel, and Cloud to verify AI-generated and edited media [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.originalTitle: Making it easier to understand how content was created and edited
items.summary:
Google is enhancing its content transparency tools by expanding the use of SynthID digital watermarking and C2PA Content Credentials across its platforms, including Search, Gemini, Chrome, Pixel devices, and Cloud services. These technologies help verify the origin and editing history of AI-generated and modified media, making it easier for users to identify authentic and altered content.

SynthID has been integrated into Google's generative media models, watermarking billions of images, videos, and audio files, while C2PA credentials provide detailed information about how media was created or edited. The Pixel 10 smartphone was the first to offer native Content Credentials for images, with video support rolling out to newer Pixel models. Verification features are also being added to the Gemini app, Search, and Chrome, allowing users to check if content is AI-generated or modified.

Google is collaborating with industry partners like OpenAI, Kakao, and ElevenLabs to broaden the adoption of these transparency standards. Additionally, Google is launching an AI Content Detection API on its Cloud platform to help businesses identify AI-generated media. These efforts aim to establish interoperable tools and global standards for media provenance, enhancing trust and clarity in digital content across platforms.

items.title: OpenAI and Malta launch AI literacy course and provide free one-year ChatGPT Plus access to all Maltese citizens starting May 2026 [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.originalTitle: OpenAI and Malta partner to bring ChatGPT Plus to all citizens
items.summary:
OpenAI and the Government of Malta have launched a partnership to provide all Maltese citizens with free one-year access to ChatGPT Plus, starting in May 2026, alongside an AI literacy course developed by the University of Malta. This initiative, part of Malta's AI for All program, aims to equip people with practical AI skills and promote responsible use of AI technology in everyday life.

The program will be managed by the Malta Digital Innovation Authority and will expand as more residents and citizens abroad complete the course. This collaboration reflects Malta's commitment to leading AI adoption by combining education with access to advanced digital tools, positioning its citizens at the forefront of the digital age and serving as a model for other countries.

Codex integrates information from various sources like CRM records, call notes, emails, and customer signals to produce initial drafts of these materials, helping sales professionals focus on strategy and relationship management.

items.title: Databricks integrates GPT-5.5 into enterprise agent workflows after model achieves new state of the art on OfficeQA Pro benchmark with 50% accuracy and 46% error reduction [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.originalTitle: Databricks brings GPT-5.5 to enterprise agent workflows
items.summary:
Databricks has integrated GPT-5.5 into its enterprise agent workflows following the model's achievement of a new state of the art on the OfficeQA Pro benchmark, where it reached 50% accuracy and reduced errors by 46% compared to its predecessor, GPT-5.4. OfficeQA Pro tests complex enterprise document tasks involving scanned PDFs, legacy files, and long-context documents, areas where GPT-5.5 showed significant improvements, particularly in parsing accuracy and workflow orchestration.

The model's enhanced ability to accurately extract data from challenging documents and efficiently manage multi-step tasks has made it more reliable for enterprise applications. Databricks now offers GPT-5.5 through its AI Unity Gateway, enabling customers to build custom workflows with AgentBricks and the Agent Supervisor API, where GPT-5.5 supervises parsing, retrieval, and execution across specialized agents, marking a notable advancement in knowledge work automation.

items.title: OpenAI details response to TanStack Mini Shai-Hulud npm supply chain attack, rotates macOS app signing certificates, and requires updates by June 26, 2026
items.originalTitle: Our response to the TanStack npm supply chain attack
items.summary:
OpenAI has responded to the TanStack "Mini Shai-Hulud" npm supply chain attack by securing its systems and rotating macOS app signing certificates. The company found no evidence of compromised user data or altered software but identified limited credential exposure in internal repositories. To enhance security, OpenAI requires macOS users to update their applications by June 26, 2026, to prevent risks associated with the compromised certificates.

The attack affected two employee devices and involved unauthorized access to some internal source code repositories. OpenAI took immediate action by isolating impacted systems, revoking credentials, and coordinating with platform providers to block unauthorized use of certificates. The company also accelerated deployment of security controls to mitigate supply chain threats and confirmed no unauthorized modifications to its published software.

OpenAI's measures include blocking new notarizations with the previous certificates and ensuring that apps signed with old certificates will be blocked by macOS security protections after the update deadline. Users can update safely through in-app updates or official links, and no action is required for Windows and iOS apps. The company remains committed to transparency and ongoing protection against evolving software supply chain risks.

items.summary:
Google DeepMind has introduced Co-Scientist, a multi-agent AI system developed with Gemini to support researchers in accelerating scientific discoveries and drug repurposing efforts. Co-Scientist functions as a collaborative partner with extensive knowledge of biomedical science, enabling it to identify connections that may be missed by researchers. Its application in chronic liver disease research highlights its potential to advance gene-regulating therapeutic approaches and accelerate progress in biomedical research.

items.title: OpenAI summarizes lessons from Parameter Golf challenge with 1,000+ participants and 2,000+ AI-assisted machine learning submissions under strict constraints [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.originalTitle: What Parameter Golf taught us about AI-assisted research
items.summary:
OpenAI's Parameter Golf challenge engaged over 1,000 participants who submitted more than 2,000 AI-assisted machine learning models under strict constraints, including a 16 MB artifact size limit and a 10-minute training budget on 8×H100 GPUs. The competition aimed to foster technical creativity in a tightly controlled environment, encouraging innovations in model design, quantization, and training optimization.

The challenge highlighted the widespread use of AI coding agents, which lowered barriers to experimentation and accelerated development, while also introducing new complexities in submission review and scoring. OpenAI identified standout submissions that demonstrated a range of approaches, from careful tuning and compression techniques to novel modeling ideas, and noted the event's success as a talent discovery platform and a reflection of evolving machine learning research practices.

Looking ahead, AutoScout24 plans to deepen AI integration within its core systems to further automate processes and improve user experiences. The company emphasizes augmenting existing capabilities with AI, aiming to empower teams and accelerate product delivery while maintaining high standards of reliability and quality.
